snippet.title: Albion Online | Visual Overhaul
snippet.description:
Albion Online’s next content update, Radiant Wilds, launches April 13. In this Dev Talk, Game Director Moritz Bokelmann and Environment Artist Johannes Geier offer a first look at the wide-ranging visual upgrade at its core.

Radiant Wilds official update page: https://albiononline.com/update/radiant-wilds

Play free now: https://albiononline.com/home
